title: The Canvas of Earth
description:
Welcome to The Canvas of Earth 🌍

A space where journeys meet imagination.

I’m Prashobh, a data science practitioner and an artist who loves exploring the stories, colors, and patterns that shape our world.

From ancient monasteries and quiet valleys to ideas that connect art, travel, and technology — every story here is a brushstroke on the canvas of Earth.

🎒 Travel | 🎨 Art | 🤖 Curiosity | ✨ Inspiration
